title: VFX
subtitle: Play the effects frame by frame, judge them in context, read how they were made, and record how they read at 1×.
filter.label: Filters
list.label: Effects
stage.label: Effect stage
stage.none: Select an effect to play it.
stage.missing: {count} frame file(s) are missing on disk; those frames draw empty.
clip.label: Clips and sections
variant.label: Palette variant
player.releaseHint: Leave the loop section and play the end
overlay.hint: Draws the effect at its anchor on a character's pivot.
overlay.pivotFrom: Character pivot {x},{y} from its anchor file; the effect anchor ({px}) sits on it.
overlay.pivotAssumed: This character has no anchor file, so its pivot is assumed to be bottom centre.
panel.label: Details
panel.none: Select an effect to see its spec, audits and provenance.
spec.none: No SpriteFX spec file was found for this effect.
spec.hashUnrecorded: no hash recorded for this spec
spec.col.name: Phase
audit.recordedNote: From {file}. These are the authors' own scores and audit counts, not a blind human read.
audit.noneRecorded: No recorded score for this effect.
audit.coreCaveat: Scores are out of 10 and self-assigned; the write-up says no three-reader blind test was run.
audit.computed: Measured now from the frames on disk
audit.computedNote: Opaque share of the canvas per frame, recomputed from the PNGs. Not the SpriteFX audit run.
audit.framesMissing: {count} frame file(s) could not be read.
audit.noThresholds: No acceptance thresholds are recorded for this effect, so the numbers are shown without a pass or fail.
prov.coreNone: No provenance file records the core effects. Only the spec, the descriptor and the write-up exist.
prov.frames: Frames: {match} of {recorded} match their recorded hash; {mismatch} differ; {missing} missing.
rounds.coreOnly: Improvement rounds were recorded for the core effects only.
rounds.none: No improvement rounds are recorded for this project.
rounds.noFrames: Only the specs of each round were kept. No frames or sheets exist for rounds 1 to 4, so the comparison below is of specs, not pictures.
rounds.someFrames: Some rounds have a sheet on disk; the rest were kept as specs only.
rounds.identical: These two rounds have identical specs.
rounds.same: Both sides show the same round.
read.intro: How does it read at its real size? Judge it at 1× on each floor below, then record your read. This is separate from the machine audits.
read.notePlaceholder: What reads, what does not, on which floor
read.stored: Stored as a comment on this effect's first frame through the review API. It never changes a review status.
read.noNotes: No human read has been recorded yet.
build.title: Build and audit
build.note: Rebuilds this effect's committed spec with the project's registered SpriteFX, twice, in scratch. It never writes into assets/ and never changes a review status.
build.running: Building twice. This takes a few seconds.
build.deterministic.no: Two builds differ: this effect is not reproducible.
build.same.byte: The rebuild is byte-identical to the {source}.
build.same.pixels: The rebuilt frames are pixel-identical to the delivered frames ({count} of {count}).
build.sheetDiffers: Its sheet bytes differ from the {source}, so this is a pixel match, not a byte match.
build.noReference: No recorded sheet hash exists to compare bytes against.
build.different: The rebuild is not identical to the delivered effect: {differing} frame(s) differ, {sizes} differ in size, {missing} missing on disk; delivered {delivered} frames, rebuilt {rebuilt}.
